skill_mismatch_analysis: cangjie-skill v2.5.0 is a text-methodology distillation meta-skill designed to convert books, long-video transcripts, podcasts, courses, and interviews into executable agent skills via the RIA-TV++ pipeline (Adler overview → 5 parallel extractors → triple verification → RIA++ capability cards → Zettelkasten links → pressure testing → compile). Its input contract explicitly requires text sources (PDF/EPUB/TXT/subtitles/transcripts), and its output is a Capability Bundle of markdown cards + YAML descriptors. It has no image input modality, no vision encoder, no pixel-level analysis capability, and no visual parameter schema. Therefore it cannot be directly invoked to extract visual design parameters from images. The mismatch is fundamental: cangjie distills propositional/methodological knowledge from text; design-compiler L1→L2 needs perceptual/quantitative parameters from pixels. This test adapts only cangjie's methodological scaffolding — atomic unit extraction, triple verification (V1 source sufficiency / V2 executability / V3 task gain), and audit trail preservation — and applies it to human-in-the-loop visual estimation.
methodology_adapted: cangjie RIA-TV++ triple-verification adapted for visual params: each parameter unit is treated as an atomic extractable; V1 checks whether visual evidence in the image is sufficient to justify the value; V2 checks whether the value type/range is consumable by a downstream renderer/generator; V3 checks whether the parameter materially contributes to reproducing the image's visual style. Confidence scores reflect V1 evidence strength.
